properties.name: agentguard.enabled
properties.description: Master switch. Nothing is intercepted until true.

properties.name: agentguard.store
properties.description: Where decisions and audit rows live. JDBC (PostgreSQL) requires a DataSource bean; MEMORY is for development only.

properties.name: agentguard.strict
properties.description: Fail startup when a tool with @ToolPolicy is not reachable through a guarded path; deny calls whose budget scope has no subject.

properties.name: agentguard.approval.max-pending-per-principal
properties.description: Decisions one principal may have waiting at once; further WRITE calls are refused (AG-APPROVAL-008).

properties.name: agentguard.approval.max-argument-bytes
properties.description: Largest arguments (UTF-8 bytes) a parked call may carry (AG-APPROVAL-009).

properties.name: agentguard.budgets.missing-subject
properties.description: What a TENANT / CONVERSATION limit does when the call carries no such id: DEFAULT (DENY under strict, else SKIP), DENY, FALLBACK_TO_PRINCIPAL, SKIP.

properties.name: agentguard.redis.pool.max-total
properties.description: Jedis pool size; set at or above peak concurrent tool calls.

properties.name: agentguard.redis.pool.min-idle
properties.description: Idle connections kept open; default = max-total so the pool never grows under virtual threads.

properties.name: agentguard.redis.pool.prepare-pool
properties.description: Open all min-idle connections at startup from a platform thread.

properties.name: agentguard.endpoints.allow-anonymous
properties.description: Trial only: accept an unauthenticated approver on the endpoints. Otherwise 401.

properties.name: agentguard.approval.allow-self-approval
properties.description: Let the principal that parked a call approve or reject it (four-eyes off).

properties.name: agentguard.approval.replay-window
properties.description: How far back an identical call is matched to an existing decision. Default: agentguard.approval.ttl.

properties.name: agentguard.approval.notifier.webhook-allow-insecure
properties.description: Trial only: allow a plain http webhook URL; https or a loopback host otherwise.

properties.name: agentguard.approval.notifier.webhook-legacy-token
properties.description: Also send the static X-AgentGuard-Token header next to the HMAC signature (one release).

properties.name: agentguard.audit.hmac-secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 key (>= 32 bytes) for the audit chain; rewrites by anyone without the key become detectable.

properties.name: agentguard.errors.include-tool-message
properties.description: Forward the tool's own exception message to the model (default: class name + correlation id).

properties.name: agentguard.endpoints.tenant-scoped
properties.description: Approvers only see and decide decisions of their own tenant.

properties.name: agentguard.redis.pool.platform-threads
properties.description: On JDK 21-23 run Redis calls on a bounded platform-thread pool so virtual threads never pin on pool growth.

properties.name: agentguard.policy.unregistered-tools
properties.description: What to do with a tool that has neither @ToolPolicy nor a ToolPolicyRegistry entry.

properties.name: agentguard.policy.approval-required-for
properties.description: Side effects that park the call for human approval.

properties.name: agentguard.approval.ttl
properties.description: How long a parked call waits for a decision before it expires.

properties.name: agentguard.approval.notifier.log-enabled
properties.description: Log parked calls at WARN (logger 'agentguard.approval').

properties.name: agentguard.approval.notifier.webhook-url
properties.description: POST a JSON payload to this URL for every parked call.

properties.name: agentguard.approval.notifier.webhook-secret
properties.description: Sent as the X-AgentGuard-Token header with every webhook.

properties.name: agentguard.jdbc.initialize-schema
properties.description: Run the bundled idempotent PostgreSQL schema (tables agentguard_*) at startup.

properties.name: agentguard.redis.uri
properties.description: Redis URI, required when agentguard.budgets.store=REDIS.

properties.name: agentguard.budgets.store
properties.description: Counter store for budgets: DEFAULT (follows agentguard.store), JDBC, REDIS, MEMORY.

properties.name: agentguard.budgets.limits
properties.description: Budget limits (scope, kind, window, limit), all enforced before dispatch.

properties.name: agentguard.redaction.sensitive-keys
properties.description: Argument keys whose values are masked in previews, logs and webhooks.

properties.name: agentguard.endpoints.enabled
properties.description: Expose the approval and audit REST endpoints. Secure them with Spring Security.
